ayahs.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَنَّ عَلَيْهِ اللَّيْلُ رَأَىٰ كَوْكَبًا ۖ قَالَ هَٰذَا رَبِّي
ayahs.translation_en: So when the night covered him, he saw a star. He said, 'This is my lord.'

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمَّا رَأَى الْقَمَرَ بَازِغًا قَالَ هَٰذَا رَبِّي
ayahs.translation_en: And when he saw the moon rising, he said, 'This is my lord.'

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمَّا رَأَى الشَّمْسَ بَازِغَةً قَالَ هَٰذَا رَبِّي هَٰذَا أَكْبَرُ
ayahs.translation_en: And when he saw the sun rising, he said, 'This is my lord; this is greater.'

ayahs.arabic: إِنِّي وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذِي فَطَرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ حَنِيفًا
ayahs.translation_en: Indeed, I have turned my face toward He who created the heavens and the earth, inclining toward truth.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ رُشْدَهُ مِن قَبْلُ
ayahs.translation_en: And We had certainly given Ibrahim his guidance before.

ayahs.arabic: فَجَعَلَهُمْ جُذَاذًا إِلَّا كَبِيرًا لَّهُمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِ يَرْجِعُونَ
ayahs.translation_en: So he made them into fragments, except a large one among them, that they might return to it.

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا حَرِّقُوهُ وَانصُرُوا آلِهَتَكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ فَاعِلِينَ
ayahs.translation_en: They said, 'Burn him and support your gods, if you are to act.'

ayahs.arabic: قُلْنَا يَا نَارُ كُونِي بَرْدًا وَسَلَامًا عَلَىٰ إِبْرَاهِيمَ
ayahs.translation_en: We said, 'O fire, be coolness and safety upon Ibrahim.'

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ السَّعْيَ قَالَ يَا بُنَيَّ إِنِّي أَرَىٰ فِي الْمَنَامِ أَنِّي أَذْبَحُكَ
ayahs.translation_en: And when he reached with him the age of exertion, he said, 'O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I must sacrifice you.'

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ يَا أَبَتِ افْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ ۖ سَتَجِدُنِي مِنَ الصَّابِرِينَ
ayahs.translation_en: He said, 'O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allah wills, of the steadfast.'
And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذْ يَرْفَعُ إِبْرَاهِيمُ الْقَوَاعِدَ مِنَ الْبَيْتِ وَإِسْمَاعِيلُ رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا
ayahs.translation_en: And when Ibrahim was raising the foundations of the House and Ismail, 'Our Lord, accept from us.'

ayahs.arabic: رَّبَّنَا إِنِّي أَسْكَنتُ مِن ذُرِّيَّتِي بِوَادٍ غَيْرِ ذِي زَرْعٍ
ayahs.translation_en: Our Lord, I have settled some of my descendants in an uncultivated valley.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذِ ابْتَلَىٰ إِبْرَاهِيمَ رَبُّهُ بِكَلِمَاتٍ فَأَتَمَّهُنَّ ۖ قَالَ إِنِّي جَاعِلُكَ لِلنَّاسِ إِمَامًا
ayahs.translation_en: And when Ibrahim was tried by his Lord with commands and he fulfilled them, He said, 'Indeed, I will make you a leader for the people.'
